تعتنقي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَنِقِي (taʕtaniqī) /taʕ.ta.ni.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# تُعْتَنَقِي (tuʕtanaqī) /tuʕ.ta.na.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
